status_definitions.IMPLEMENTED: The behavior exists in source but is not covered by the automated evidence identified in this ledger.
status_definitions.AUTOMATED-VERIFIED: The behavior is covered by passing automated tests identified in the public evidence index; this status is not live-system certification.
status_definitions.LIVE-VERIFIED: The exact behavior and stated device/environment boundary passed a dated human or live-system check.
status_definitions.EXPERIMENTAL: The behavior exists behind a limited or incomplete acceptance boundary and must not be presented as generally reliable.
status_definitions.PLANNED: The behavior is specified or designed but is not a shipped showcase capability.

claims.allowed_wording: The voice-study core separates transcription, dialogue, grading, speech synthesis, turn detection, and transport behind provider-neutral contracts.
limitations: The initial public demonstration uses deterministic fakes, not every possible provider.

claims.allowed_wording: The official answer is structurally absent from pre-answer model context and becomes available only after the reveal boundary.
limitations: Each future adapter must continue to pass the same context-boundary tests.
prohibited_overclaim: all future adapters are automatically safe

claims.allowed_wording: The tutoring layer supports deterministic Brazilian Portuguese and English response selection, mixed-language turns, scoped medical-abbreviation expansion, and explicit ambiguity handling.
limitations: The glossary is curated and intentionally finite.
prohibited_overclaim: perfect pronunciation for every mixed-language utterance

claims.allowed_wording: The grading contract distinguishes correct, partial, incorrect, and ungradable answers, identifies covered or missing concepts, and fails closed on malformed, contradictory, or low-confidence output.
limitations: A grading result is study feedback, not a clinical judgment.
prohibited_overclaim: autonomous authority to submit a study rating

claims.allowed_wording: A proposed study rating remains inert until the learner explicitly confirms it; transcript correction invalidates the prior grade and requires reevaluation.
limitations: The public demo simulates the adapter action and does not modify a real collection.
prohibited_overclaim: voice inference alone authorizes a review

claims.allowed_wording: After grading or a no-attempt reveal, the system waits silently; it reads only the answer side after an explicit request, while repeating or explaining the question requires a separate request.
limitations: The complete cross-device real-hardware acceptance matrix remains open.
prohibited_overclaim: the official answer can never be interrupted under every browser and provider condition

claims.allowed_wording: Protected card readings wait for correlated producer completion and local audio drain, while open discussion uses a separate interruption path; microphone release does not depend on a fixed playback-duration timer.
limitations: Hardware echo behavior and operating-system lifecycle behavior still require device-specific evidence.

claims.allowed_wording: The current voice route experimentally preserves ordered answer fragments across short recall pauses and supports explicit keep-thinking and finish controls.
limitations: The same completion contract has not yet been accepted across every provider-neutral route.

claims.allowed_wording: The integration leaves collection synchronization, due state, and scheduling with a user-owned Anki installation while using tokenized, idempotent reveal and review operations at the application boundary.
limitations: The public demo uses a deterministic fake and is independently developed and unaffiliated with Anki or AnkiWeb.

claims.allowed_wording: An explicit transit profile can exclude cards requiring visual interaction without silently falling back to unconstrained selection; full study supports authorized card-media paths.
limitations: Transit is selected explicitly; the system does not infer that the learner is traveling.

claims.allowed_wording: The private voice pipeline records normalized usage and estimated cost, applies configurable warning and hard-limit policies, and keeps route capabilities explicit.
limitations: Provider prices and exchange rates are dated inputs; the credential-free public demo has no paid-model cost.
prohibited_overclaim: current fixed budget in Brazilian reais

claims.allowed_wording: Automated Chromium and WebKit checks exercise the principal phone, tablet, and desktop viewport walkthroughs together with keyboard, focus, accessible-name, contrast, reduced-motion, and voice-status checks.
limitations: Viewport automation is not native-app or full real-device acceptance; permission, reconnect, orientation-change, and operating-system background lifecycle behavior remain outside this evidence.

claims.allowed_wording: This source-only showcase includes a deterministic local demonstration with original synthetic cards, fake providers, responsive web UI, and no required model, card-service, or private-network credentials.
limitations: This repository is source-only; browser automation covers Chromium and WebKit viewports rather than native or real-device acceptance, and fake speech is an audible deterministic tone rather than natural synthesized speech.
prohibited_overclaim: the demo calls a live AI provider

claims.allowed_wording: A future general personal-assistant system is separate planned work; Voice Study Companion is a study application, not that assistant.
limitations: General conversation, ambient presence, memory, connectors, and workplace orchestration are outside this showcase.

claims.allowed_wording: Coordinated cross-device sessions, voice-authority handoff, background lifecycle support, named-screen presentation, and shared visual attention remain planned and are outside the current showcase.
limitations: Current responsive-web evidence does not establish coordinated device presence.
